_note: First-screen course fact blocks for per-method Level I/II course pages. Rendered by src/components/CourseFactsBlock.tsx (React) and scripts/training-na.mjs (prerender) from this one file. hoursKey refers to src/data/snt-tc-1a-hours.json; null = no SNT-TC-1A row exists, so the block links to the matrix instead of quoting numbers. No prices, no dates. 2026-10-12: hoursKeys (array) sums several methods (NDT Level I/II = the five-method package VT, PT, MT, UT, RT, matching the US flyer's 104 h / 112 h); workloadLevels sums several levels (MT Level I and II course); courseHours is an OWNER INPUT for courses with no SNT-TC-1A row (PAUT, TOFD, Level II recertification) — null until the owner confirms the course's classroom hours. The same hours feed CourseInstance.courseWorkload via src/data/course-markup-2026-10.mjs.
